en-US.name: ADHD Habit Tracker
en-US.summary: Track your daily habits and focus sessions hands-free with your voice.
en-US.description: ADHD Habit Tracker lets you log completed habits, check your daily progress, and start Pomodoro focus timers — all without touching your phone or computer. Say 'Alexa, open Habit Tracker' to get started.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Enable the skill, then say 'Alexa, open Habit Tracker'.
